# Pull request

Replace the prompts with the observed result and its scope before posting.

## Problem and change

Describe the problem and changed behavior.
State the assigned acceptance and exclusions.
Link the original issue when there is one.
Use `Closes #number` only when the PR closes it.

## Verification

Use one table row per command.

| Command | Exit status | Observed result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| | | |

Name the unchanged inputs for reused evidence.
Explain the reason and effect of each failure or unexecuted check.

## Review and ownership

Record the observed results under their gates:

- Exposure inspection.
- Hosted checks.
- Independent review.

State the assigned stop point and the owner of each remaining action.
